thread:
alex_k: Quick sync — catalog orchestration owners needed for three new open models we plan to include in the initial catalog push: aurora-7b, cypress-13b, papyrus-3b. Need: license sign-off, perf profiles (quant & fp16), and a deployment target (canary plan). Please ack and call out blockers. Canaries target week of Apr 6.

maria: Ack. Quick Q — is cypress licensed for commercial use? I thought there was a non-commercial clause for a fork.

olivia_legal: @maria short answer: cypress-13b upstream uses a permissive license but there's a downstream dataset attribution clause we need to confirm. I've pinged the maintainer for the attribution doc; ETA EOD Tue. Marking cypress as license_pending.

cheng: Adding perf snapshot for quick visibility (local bench, A10x, batch=8):
```
aurora-7b: p95=120ms, tok/s=420
papyrus-3b: p95=95ms, tok/s=760
cypress-13b: still pending (OOM on single A10x w/ fp16)
```
Papyrus needs a quant profile; aurora looks good. Cypress likely needs 8x A100-style instances or a quantized variant to fit our canary SLO.

jamal: GPU note: we have one A10x rack free for canary but not enough for cypress-13b at target QPS. If we want to include cypress in the first wave we should either: 1) use a quantized build, or 2) reserve additional capacity (estimate: 8 cards @ 100 qps). I can request burst capacity but need PM sign-off.

ben_p: For rollout — recommend policy: prefer aurora-7b as primary for general workloads, papyrus-3b as low-latency fallback, and cypress-13b as heavy-duty batch lane if we get license & infra. Also suggest model routing matrix so we can fallback automatically if mem pressure.

sara_r: From product side: milestones — legal sign-off Wed, perf profiles due Thu, infra capacity decision Fri, canary Mon Apr 8. If legal slips we move cypress to wave2. I'm ok with aurora+papyrus in wave1.

ops-bot: Checklist update: license_pending:cypress-13b, perf_ready:aurora-7b, perf_incomplete:cypress-13b, quant_needed:papyrus-3b

jamal: I can run the quant tests for papyrus and a quantized sanity pass for cypress if @cheng can produce a reproducible model artifact (weights + tokenizer + config). Tagging @cheng for handoff.

cheng: Will push artifacts to s3://redwood-models/candidates/papyrus-3b/ and s3://redwood-models/candidates/cypress-13b/ by EOD today. I'll include a small runbook: commands and minimal env to reproduce perf.

alex_k: Owners assigned: cheng -> perf + artifacts, olivia_legal -> license sign-off (cypress), jamal -> infra + quant runs, sara_r -> PM milestone owner, ben_p -> routing/rollout config. Next steps: cheng upload + runbook (EOD), olivia confirm license (EOD Tue), jamal run quant tests (Thu), infra capacity call Fri. If anything slips, call it out here. Thanks — alex_k :thumbsup:
notes: short thread, cross-team coordination for model onboarding and catalog launch
